item_short_desc: Rothco's Carabiner Compass and Thermometer is a compact, multi-functional tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts. Measuring 2.75 inches x 1.375 inches x 0.375 inch, it conveniently clips onto your outdoor gear for easy access. The built-in compass provides reliable navigation, while the thermometer offers dual Fahrenheit and Celsius readings to track the temperature in various climates.
description: Rothco's Carabiner Compass and Thermometer is a compact, multi-functional tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts.
